posts.title: Why We Built Space AI: Open Machine Intelligence for Scientific Discovery
posts.description: Our research agenda across four linked problems: discovering verifiable science with machines, optimizing models to run lean and transparently, pulling distributed intelligence together, and keeping the entire stack open.

posts.title: Solving the Maze: Exact Proofs and Neural Grandmasters in Quoridor
posts.description: Computer-verified phase-transition theorems on 5x5 and 7x7 Quoridor — including the single vertical wall that flips the exact winner — alongside a 2,600+ Elo neural self-play engine trained in under an hour on one workstation.

posts.title: Glass-Box Chat: Live Interpretability and Causal Interventions in Space Chat
posts.description: How we built live token-level decision geometry, 1-click counterfactual forking, antisymmetric paired-swap honesty auditing, and 5-framing sycophancy stress-tests directly into an interactive chat interface.

posts.title: Algorithmic Core Extraction: Four Inference Speedups on a Single Workstation
posts.description: Open benchmarks from our ace-inference suite: 484x MicroCore offloading, 4x-16x balanced-truncation state reduction with fused Triton kernels, +38.9% 4-bit accuracy via anti-inflation scheduling, and lossless cross-family speculative decoding.

posts.title: Auditable Private AI: Air-Gapped Local Mode and Blind-Relay E2EE
posts.description: Why privacy claims require fail-closed invariants rather than soft logging promises: loopback-only air-gap enforcement, coordinator-blind X25519/AES-256-GCM remote inference (<1 ms overhead), and an honest hardware threat model.

posts.title: Knowledge Boundary Fingerprinting: Verifying Open Models Without Slow Proofs
posts.description: How our open network catches silent model downgrades across heterogeneous NVIDIA GPUs and Apple Silicon Macs using open SHA-256 capability-cliff probe packs, signed receipts, and lightweight cross-hardware spot-checks.

posts.title: Blackwell Silicon Engineering: Accelerating Inkling-2-Mini and Qwen3.8-27B on RTX 5090
posts.description: Roofline-driven CUDA 13 kernels, 128-bit PDL MMVQ, on-load NVFP4 coda experts, and VMM ElasticArray KV caches delivering +41.6% prefill, +17.2% decode, and up to 11.2 GiB VRAM savings on a single 32 GiB workstation GPU.

posts.title: Emma's Voice: Private On-Device Lip, Tongue, and Cheek Tracking for Non-Verbal Autism Imitation
posts.short_title: Emma's Voice: On-Device Lip & Tongue Tracking
posts.description: A 100% browser-native tablet companion pairing MediaPipe Face Landmarker, hybrid inner-mouth pink-tongue chroma tracking, 3D cheek-puff geometry, Pixar-style Three.js animal buddies, and local Piper VITS neural speech with zero cloud upload.

posts.title: Space Quant Lab: Causal Meta-Ensembles for Leveraged Bitcoin Trading
posts.short_title: Space Quant Lab: Causal BTC Meta-Ensembles
posts.description: A zero-lookahead 24/7 paper-trading and backtesting lab built on Multiplicative-Weights (Hedge) online meta-learning over four orthogonal experts, volatility-targeted leverage (1x-20x), and realistic perpetual funding & liquidation mechanics (+34.9% over 90d 4h vs -20.6% B&H, 0 liquidations).

posts.title: CoreRank Discovery: Mining Surprising, Non-Common-Knowledge Findings Across 1,715 AI Papers
posts.description: Why naive 1D surprise probes fail (rho=0.098), and how combining Bayesian prior-vs-rigor cores, 8-axis topic-canceled mechanism bridges, and de-biased Stage-2 Keep-1D contradictions surfaces zero-citation gems (+2.05 4B lift, -53.5% order bias).

posts.title: Turning Idle GPU Bandwidth Into 3x Reasoning Accuracy (and Two Ideas That Failed)
posts.short_title: Adaptive TTC: 3x Accuracy on One RTX 5090
posts.description: How intent-aware thinking, 4-slot continuous batching, DeepConf tail-confidence weighting, 3-of-4 early quorum cancellation, and conditional GenRM verification lifted Qwen3.8-27B from 31.2% to 93.8% on 16 hard AIME/code problems for +8.8% wall time — plus two honest negative results.

posts.title: Steerable Before Decodable: Multi-Model Causal Evidence of Unembedding-Orthogonal Bottlenecks Beyond the Logit and Tuned Lens
posts.short_title: Steerable Before Decodable: Multi-Model Causal Evidence
posts.description: Steerable before decodable across 3 architectures (1.7B-7.2B, 2,016 held-out cross-lexicon pairs): At peak causal steering depth, ACE readout (0.766) exceeds both Direct Logit Lens (0.709, p=4.61e-02) and Trained Residual-Affine Tuned Lens (0.708, p=6.47e-02), with mean unembedding alignment |cos(q_l*, dW_U)| = 0.143.
posts.experiment_metrics: ACE Flip +0.23 vs CAA +0.16 (p=7.3e-04) · Keep-1D wins 12/12

posts.title: Silent Cancellation and Backward Gradient Corruption in Low-Precision KL Divergence: Analysis and Fused Triton Kernels
posts.short_title: Low-Precision KL Gradient Corruption & Fused Triton Kernels
posts.description: Forward & backward gradient corruption across 36 regimes (Wilcoxon p=1.45e-11): PyTorch F.kl_div returns negative values on up to 50.4% of inputs and corrupts BF16 reverse-KL gradients (eps=1e-2) with 39.1% sign flips (cos=0.589). Clamping F.kl_div.clamp(min=0) induces 50.4% silent zero-gradient dead-zones and 61.8% sign flips (cos=0.371).
posts.category_label: SYSTEMS FOR ML & NUMERICAL STABILITY · VERSION 2.0
posts.experiment_metrics: Triton 6.5x faster · -80% VRAM @ V=152k · 0.0% neg KL

posts.title: Margin-Gated Probabilistic Surrogate Gradients for Overcomplete Sparse Autoencoders
posts.short_title: Margin-Gated Probabilistic Surrogates for Overcomplete SAEs
posts.description: Active-set gating completely eliminates v1's FVU penalty across 18 paired 4x-overcomplete runs (2 LLM families x 3 k x 3 seeds): MarginProb-BatchTopK lowers FVU vs. ungated v1 ProbBatchTopK by -0.01569 (95% CI [-0.01837, -0.01301], paired t p=1.95e-09; Qwen3 k=32: 0.2996 -> 0.2796; SmolLM2 k=32: 0.2826 -> 0.2720).
